newsitem.title: UK: Racal gains after postive press comment.
newsitem.headline: Racal gains after postive press comment.

text.p: Shares in Britain's Racal Electronics Plc rose on Monday after positive weekend press comment, traders said.
The stock was up 6-1/2p at 245 by 1013 GMT, after last week plummeting to a year's low of 218p after the company issued a profits warning the day before releasing its first-half results.

The Sunday Times "Agenda" column said despite last week's fall, long-term holders of the stock "should not be too gloomy" and that chairman Sir Ernest Harrison had a "remarkable ability" to spot opportunities.

It said one option might be for Racal to invite in as a partner a foreign group keen to break into the UK telephone market. "Such a deal could realise value for shareholders and make the shares motor again," the report said.
